aiVerification.summary: Draft has comparable normal/test function data but changed-factor and outcome grouping need correction before use.
issues: Changed factor is narrowed to jig only despite source defining a multi-part Option 2 condition.
Test 2nd is compared to an earlier Normal row, so date/test-round grouping is not preserved.
Measurement outcome is invalid; it appears derived from table/header fields, not a real measurement comparison.
Recheck NG using old JIG rows are omitted or not classified, though they affect interpretation.
Evidence cites row 10.7!38 without visible support in provided context.
requiredUserQuestions: Does "Test new JIG" mean the full Option 2 condition or only the jig change?
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor as Normal vs Option 2/full test condition unless user confirms jig-only.
Separate subresults by date and test round; do not compare Test 2nd to prior Normal without justification.
Remove the measurement outcome unless actual measurement/spec rows exist.
Add or explicitly exclude old-JIG recheck rows as secondary recheck context.
Ensure all cited evidence rows are present and support the exact claims.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove source existence but are insufficient for final evidence because key grouping and metric support are unclear.
